text:
incident-bot: ALERT: api-gateway-edges (prod) reporting spike in 5xx (502/504). severity: P2. started: 2025-04-12T12:03:12Z. error-rate: 14% over 5m (baseline ~0.5%). top code: 502,504. paging on-call. :rotating_light:

alice (oncall): acked. looking now — thanks. who owns edge routing?

bob (edge): i can take initial triage. quick metrics: majority of errors originate from us-west-2 edge tier, upstream timeouts to backend pool (upstream 504) and immediate 502s from proxy.

carol (sre): any recent deploys / infra changes around 12:00?

dan (platform): there was a config push to kong edge rules at 12:01 by ci-bot (rollout id r-20250412-332). rolling back now as a quick test.

misha (eng-infra): adding logs for quick scan — sample from edge nginx: 
```
2025-04-12T12:03:19Z edge-01 10.1.4.11 - - "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1" 502 523 "-" "curl/7.68.0" upstream_status:504 upstream_response_time:1.02
2025-04-12T12:03:20Z edge-02 10.1.4.12 - - "POST /v1/chat HTTP/1.1" 502 498 "-" "python-requests/2.25" upstream_status:502 upstream_response_time:0.12
```

bob (edge): reproducer from curl on edge: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/2 502
"502 Bad Gateway"
```

alice (oncall): roll back applied? status?

dan (platform): rollback started at 12:06. rolling back to kong-config r-20250412-310. will monitor.

carol (sre): while rollback in flight, let's enable fallback routing to secondary origin pool and increase retries on gateway (2 -> 4) for 10m. who can flip those?

bob (edge): i can toggle fallback. starting route-shift to origin-secondary (warm) for 25% traffic to mitigate. doing small increments.

misha (eng-infra): scaling gateway workers by +40% in us-west-2, command: `kubectl scale deployment api-gateway --replicas=14 -n prod-usw2` — scaling now.

elena (support): getting customer reports — some customers complaining about intermittent 502s and long waits. CS triage: 47 customers with >5% error rates, 3 enterprise customers reporting production impact. updating status page.

alice (oncall): good. please patch status page message to note degraded API responses and that we're working on mitigation.

bob (edge): route-shift 10% -> 25% -> 50% in progress. at 12:12 we saw error-rate dip from 14% to ~7% after initial 25% shift.

incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty incident #INC-42819 open, acknowledged by alice at 2025-04-12T12:05:02Z. severity P2.

carol (sre): observation: upstream timeouts correspond to a small set of backends — looks like backend pool B (model-serving-pool-b) experiencing resource contention. logs show accept queue saturations.

dan (platform): confirming — autoscaler for pool B failed to trigger because of a stray label mismatch from last config push. that explains why pool didn't scale under load. i pushed a temporary manual scale to pool B (+3 pods).

misha (eng-infra): after manual scale and route-shift, errors dropped to ~2.5% in last 2m. warming caches and KV stores.

elena (support): customers on status page updated. no critical enterprise SLA breaches reported yet, but some are seeing automated retries fail.

alice (oncall): handoff — i'll stay for 10 more minutes then hand to carol for postmortem and follow-up. carol, can you own the post-incident and RCA?

carol (sre): yes, i'll take it. steps to include in RCA: kong config validation missing for rollout, autoscaler label regression, improved preflight checks, and a safer canary for routing rules. also propose playbook change: if error-rate >5% and rollback doesn't fully mitigate in 3m, trigger auto-route-shift to warm pool.

dan (platform): i'll add a CI blocker that prevents config rollouts without kong-schema validation and add a test that verifies autoscaler labels.

bob (edge): re: mitigation, i've kept route-shift at 50% and increased gateway retries to 4 for 15m. will monitor error-rate and latency.

elena (support): opening support tickets for the 3 enterprise customers, notifying AMs, ETA to next update 13:00 UTC.

alice (oncall): final checks before handoff: error-rate 2.1% last 1m, lat p95 back to baseline, no new deploys. paging cleared for me. handing to carol.

carol (sre): ack. capturing runbook steps executed: rollback kong -> manual scale pool B -> route-shift -> increased retries -> status updates. will create INCIDENT-42819 postmortem doc and assign follow-ups to dan (platform) and bob (edge).

misha (eng-infra): leaving a snippet of queries used for triage: 
```
# peak error rates by region
select region, count(*) as errors from edge_logs where status in (502,504) and ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by region order by errors desc;
```

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place. status: degraded -> recovering. next update in 45m or if regression occurs.

carol (sre): adding immediate action items: (1) add kong preflight validation (dan) (2) autoscaler label test + repair job (dan) (3) improve canary for edge routing (bob) (4) support communication templates (elena). assigning now.

elena (support): noted. i'll prepare customer communication drafts and send AM notes.

alice (oncall): thanks team. leaving channel — take it from here, carol. :heart:

carol (sre): thanks — will kick off the postmortem and link runbook. closing live triage.
